confirmedSafeAreas.finding: Unset or blank configuration returns the original API without recording filesystem operations.

digest: Default behavior is preserved; enabled recording needs failure-contract, integration-test, and operational-safety work.

needsHuman.question: Should recording be best-effort, or may it deliberately fail workflow operations? Strict behavior is observable but its intent is not established.
Confirm bounded, private, single-writer sessions are the supported model, including inherited child-process configuration; broader support requires stronger isolation and storage safeguards.
Provide fresh test and packaging results. Execution, registry access, and release-environment readiness were not verified in this read-only review.

nonBlockingIssues.action: Use exclusive fresh directories; add session identity or reject reuse before supporting shared or multi-session recording.
nonBlockingIssues.issue: Directory reuse or sharing appends calls with restarting sequence numbers while overwriting API-surface metadata, potentially mixing replay sessions.

nonBlockingIssues.action: Keep use bounded and private; measure representative payloads and consider permissions, size limits, redaction, and retention before broader adoption.
nonBlockingIssues.issue: Enabled recording performs synchronous, unbounded serialization and writes without redaction or retention controls.
